title: Spanish Berry Dumplings
description: A delicious dessert made with a sweet Spanish-inspired filling and soft dumplings.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the berries, sloe, and sugar.
2. In a separate bowl, mix the dough mix with eggs and milk.
3. Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1 cm.
4. Use a round cookie cutter to cut out circles of dough.
5. Place a tablespoon of the berry mixture in the center of each dough circle.
6. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
7. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
8. Cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the dumplings float to the surface.
9. Serve warm with a drizzle of honey, if desired.
